description: Physics puzzle destroyer starring Blaze & Boulder. Flick ice blocks across the rink to smash every crystal target — chain smashes for combo multipliers!
fireSafetyLesson: Ice and water cool things down — but NEVER touch ice on a real frozen lake without a grown-up!
title: Cinder's Ice Rink Chaos

description: Vertical arcade runner starring Ruko & Sizzle. Drag to dodge falling magma boulders, tap to fire ember bolts at rock gargoyles. Chain kills for combo!
fireSafetyLesson: Boulders are dangerous — in real life, NEVER climb on rocky cliffs or near volcanoes!
title: Lord Inferno's Ballista Siege

description: Top-down arena bumper starring Boulder & Cinder. Fling Blaze around the arena to bump grumpy rock golems into cooling pools. Chain splashes for combo!
fireSafetyLesson: Cool water puts out heat — but if YOU get hurt, tell a grown-up right away!
title: Blaze's Magma Bounce

description: Rhythm tap-timing game starring Sizzle & Lord Inferno. Tap the drums in rhythm as notes drift down 4 lanes — perfect hits build your combo multiplier!
fireSafetyLesson: Rhythm keeps you calm — in an emergency, slow breaths help you think clearly!
title: Ruko's Turbo Drift

description: Endless hopper starring Cinder & Blaze. Bounce Sizzle ever higher on glowing platforms, steer with taps, grab stars for bonuses. Don't fall!
fireSafetyLesson: Always look where you're going — climbing high places needs a grown-up nearby!
title: Sizzle's Spark Jump

description: Castle defense ballista aim starring Lord Inferno & Ruko. Drag to aim, release to fire at incoming rock golem waves. Survive all 8 waves!
fireSafetyLesson: Defending your home starts with prevention — check smoke alarms every month!
title: Ember Cascade

description: Match-3 physics drop starring Blaze & Boulder. Tap columns to drop ember blocks, match 3+ of the same color to blast them away. Don't let the stack reach the top!
fireSafetyLesson: Stacked things can topple — keep heavy items low and away from heat!
title: Caldera Climb

description: Endless dodge & collect starring Ruko & Sizzle. Sprint through the trench, tap to jump lava geysers and rock slides, grab crystals for combo bonuses!
fireSafetyLesson: Lava is VERY hot — in real life, stay far away from anything burning or melting!
title: Magma Trench Dodge

description: Tug-of-war physics pinball starring Boulder & Cinder. Hold to charge the plunger, tap left/right to flip the fire-baby flippers. 3 balls, endless combos!
fireSafetyLesson: Pinball is all fun — but real machines run on electricity. Never poke inside them!
title: Volcanic Pinball

description: Platformer speedrun starring Sizzle & Lord Inferno. Auto-sprint through the track, tap to jump spike pits and lava gaps, grab time-crystals to shave seconds. Beat the clock!
fireSafetyLesson: Fast feet save lives — practice moving quickly AND safely to your family's meeting spot!
title: Pyra Prime Defense

description: Swinging grapple arcade starring Cinder & Blaze. Hold to grapple glowing anchors and swing, release at the right moment to fly. Grab stars, dodge storm clouds!
fireSafetyLesson: Hold on tight in life too — always use handrails on stairs and playgrounds!
title: Sparky Speedway

description: Grid strategy tactical starring Lord Inferno & Ruko. Turn-based 6x6 battles — move your 3 fire babies, melt adjacent rock golems, survive their counterattacks!
fireSafetyLesson: Think before you act — having a plan keeps everyone safe, just like a fire escape plan!
title: Cinder's Melt-Down
